garden.heading: Garden
garden.hint: Pick a cell to plant something there, or to see what’s growing.

errors.cellOccupied: That cell already has a plant. Remove it first.

bedEditor.heading: New bed
bedEditor.sizeHint: Each cell holds one plant; up to {max} × {max}.

errors.sizeAtLeastOne: Rows and columns must be at least 1.
errors.sizeWhole: Rows and columns must be whole numbers.
errors.sizeAtMost: Rows and columns can be at most {max}.

catalog.heading: Plant catalog
catalog.filtersOn: {count, plural, one {# filter on} other {# filters on}}
catalog.shownOf: Showing {shown} of {total, plural, one {# plant} other {# plants}}

plant.pickMonths: Click the months to pick them.
plant.readOnly: This is a built-in plant, so its care rules are read-only.
plant.monthPartHint: Beginning = 1st–15th, end = 16th to the last day.
plant.deleteMessage: “{name}” will be deleted, together with its care rules.
plant.deleteHistory: {count, plural, one {# completed task} other {# completed tasks}} from earlier plantings will be deleted too, also from your calendar.
plant.sourceUrlHint: A page about the plant, e.g. on a nursery’s website.
plant.rulesNote: Changes to care rules apply to new plantings; tasks already created stay as they are.

errors.offsetRequired: Offset days is required for an offset rule.
errors.offsetInvalid: Offset days must be a whole number of 0 or more.
errors.recurrenceRequired: Recurrence days is required for a recurring rule.
errors.recurrenceInvalid: Recurrence days must be a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.monthRequired: Choose the month for a yearly rule.
errors.wateringInvalid: Watering must be a whole number of days from 1 to 365.
errors.sourceUrlInvalid: The source link must be a web address starting with http:// or https://.
errors.inGarden: This plant is in {count, plural, one {the bed} other {the beds}} {beds} right now. Remove it from the garden first, then you can delete it.

traits.noLifeCycle: Shrubs and trees have no life cycle here.

lookup.heading: On Wikipedia for “{query}”
lookup.cultivarNote: “{cultivar}” itself isn’t on Wikipedia; the details are for {plant}.
lookup.prefilled: Pre-filled from Wikipedia: check the details and choose the sun requirement.

errors.unreachable: Samwise’s server couldn’t be reached, so nothing was searched. Please try again in a moment.
errors.failed: The search on Wikipedia failed. Please try again later.

photos.uploadHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. They’re reduced to about 1600 px before uploading and are visible only to you.
photos.linkHint: The picture stays on its website and is shown from there; nothing is copied. Respect the website’s terms: some don’t allow using their photos.
photos.wikipediaNone: Wikipedia has no free picture of this plant.
photos.deleteMessage: The photo will be removed from this plant.
photos.broken: The picture couldn’t be loaded (it may have been moved or removed from its website).

errors.noFiles: Choose one or more photos first.
errors.unreadable: “{file}” isn’t a picture the browser can read (e.g. HEIC from an iPhone: save it as JPEG first).
errors.linkInvalid: Enter a web address starting with http:// or https://.

language.heading: Language
language.label: Language
language.hint: Used for Samwise and for the events on your “Samwise” calendar.
language.savedCalendar: Language saved. Your calendar events will switch to it shortly.

calendar.heading: Google Calendar
calendar.intro: Samwise can put your garden tasks on a separate “Samwise” calendar in your Google account. It can only see and change that calendar, none of your others.
calendar.connectedText: New and changed tasks appear on your “Samwise” calendar.
calendar.disconnectHint: Disconnecting deletes the “Samwise” calendar from Google Calendar.
calendar.reconnectRevoked: Samwise’s access to your Google Calendar was removed in your Google account, so tasks aren’t syncing. Reconnect to resume; your “Samwise” calendar will be reused.
calendar.reconnectDeleted: Your “Samwise” calendar was deleted in Google Calendar, so tasks aren’t syncing. Reconnect to create it again.
calendar.confirmDisconnect: This deletes your “Samwise” calendar and all its events from Google Calendar.
calendar.connectedStatus: Google Calendar connected. {count, plural, one {# upcoming task is} other {# upcoming tasks are}} on your “Samwise” calendar.
calendar.connectedFailed: {count, plural, one {# task couldn’t be added yet and will sync when it next changes.} other {# tasks couldn’t be added yet and will sync when they next change.}}
calendar.disconnected: Google Calendar disconnected, and your “Samwise” calendar was deleted.
calendar.disconnectedKept: Google Calendar disconnected. Samwise no longer had access to delete your “Samwise” calendar, so delete it in Google Calendar if you don’t want it.

errors.unreachableConnect: Samwise’s server couldn’t be reached, so Google Calendar wasn’t connected. Please try again in a moment.
errors.unreachableDisconnect: Samwise’s server couldn’t be reached, so Google Calendar is still connected. Please try again in a moment.
errors.devHint: (Local development: is “npx supabase functions serve” running?)
errors.access_denied: You didn’t allow calendar access, so nothing was connected.
errors.state_mismatch: Google’s response didn’t match this browser session. Please try connecting again.
errors.google_rejected_code: Google didn’t accept the sign-in (it may have expired). Please try connecting again.
errors.connectFailed: Couldn’t connect Google Calendar. Please try again.
errors.disconnectFailed: Couldn’t disconnect Google Calendar. Please try again.
